final_message:
I've written the patent portfolio summary report, and it passed the docx validator and parse-doc. The main conclusion is that the draft Exhibit A patent schedule can't be finalized as written. Greenleaf's own internal tracker describes a different portfolio from the schedule and the Thornbury diligence report for 17 of the 18 patent families. US 10,234,567, the patent on the lead compound, also appears to have lapsed for an unpaid maintenance fee.

The report logs 30 discrepancies by severity. The ones that matter most:

- **Two different portfolios (Critical).** Only Family 001 matches across all three documents. For 002–018 the tracker has different titles, numbers, filing dates, inventors and status. Only one issued US patent appears in both the schedule and the tracker. The tracker also lists five other issued US patents that are not on the schedule.
- **US 10,234,567 likely expired (Critical).** Both the diligence report and the tracker put the fee deadline six months late. The fee was due September 19, 2022, and the last day to pay with surcharge was March 20, 2023. The tracker shows it unpaid as of October 1, 2023, so reinstatement would need a petition under 37 C.F.R. § 1.378.
- **Late filings (High).** On the schedule's own dates, the follow-on US and PCT applications were filed after the 12-month deadline in six families. Family 001 was 11 days late; 002, 003, 004, 012 and 015 were 1–3 days late. The Japanese entry in Family 001 was about 30 days late. Unless restored by petition, the listed priority dates don't hold.
- **Family 014 priority date (High).** The schedule says March 1, 2016 and the diligence report says February 19, 2015. The tracker instead shows a different, still-pending application and doesn't list US 10,952,178 at all.
- **Schedule errors (High).**
  - It leaves out granted Chinese patent CN 107,531,672.
  - It still shows EP 3,463,301 as pending; the tracker records it granted on November 14, 2023.
  - Its summary statistics are wrong: 13 PCT applications instead of 14, 15 pending instead of 22, 38 "Filed" instead of 31.
  - It shows US application 16/194,712 where the other two documents have 16/194,721, probably a typo.
- **Inventors and ownership unverified (High).** The schedule names only Drs. Vasquez and Hale, while the tracker names four other scientists. The diligence report checked only a sample of the inventors' assignment agreements, so the seller's statement that Greenleaf is sole owner isn't supported yet.

The report also covers counts by source, a family-by-family status table, deadline and maintenance-fee checks, specific diligence requests, schedule corrections, and proposed purchase agreement protections. Appendices give a row-by-row reconciliation and list the tracker-only filings.

All of this comes from the three documents alone; no patent office records were checked, and the report says so. "Verified" in it means consistent across the documents and with the filing-deadline rules, not confirmed a
